meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: 你让它清理死代码时,它会扫描项目里没被引用的导入、函数、类型,用 LSP 核对引用后分批删除;每批通过类型检查后单独提交,最后给出删除清单与 typecheck、test、build 结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup”等关键词,或要求清理项目里未使用的代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目里的死代码清掉。
say.note: 先扫描并用 LSP 验证,再分批删除提交

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的未使用代码。
say.note: 把扫描范围收窄到该目录

say.text: unusedFunc 还有人用吗?没人用就删掉。
say.note: 按符号名限定扫描范围

howto.what_en: When you ask it to clean up, it scans the project for unused imports, functions and types, confirms each via LSP references, removes them in parallel batches with one commit per batch, then reports removals plus typecheck and build results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup” and similar keywords, or ask to clean up unused code in the project.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project.
say_en.note: Scans, verifies with LSP, then removes in batches

say_en.text: Only clean up unused code under src/utils.
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Is unusedFunc still used? Remove it if not.
